products.name: Workspace ONE to Intune — iOS/iPadOS Device Migration — Commercial
products.short_description: The repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune iOS/iPadOS migration — Apple Business Manager MDM-server re-assignment, Intune enrollment profiles, app/profile parity, and a ringed cutover with clear user comms. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Move iPhones and iPads from Workspace ONE to Intune — with Apple Business Manager done right

Apple devices are the trickiest part of a Workspace ONE exit: supervised, ADE-enrolled iPhones and iPads must be re-assigned in Apple Business Manager and re-enrolled into Intune — often a wipe-and-re-enroll — with app and profile parity and minimal user disruption. This solution is the repeatable Workspace ONE to Intune iOS/iPadOS migration: ABM MDM-server re-assignment, Intune enrollment profiles, app/profile parity, and a ringed cutover with clear user comms.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Apple migration model, moving devices in Apple Business Manager from the Workspace ONE MDM server to Intune, supervised ADE re-enrollment (and the wipe-and-re-enroll reality), app/profile parity, and the ringed cutover.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, Apple Business Manager + the Apple MDM Push (APNs) certificate and ADE token, Workspace ONE/ABM admin access, app/profile parity target, a pilot group, user comms) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: connect ABM to Intune, build Intune enrollment profiles, reassign devices in ABM, re-enroll (wipe where required) by ring, restore app/profile parity, validate, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — iOS migration-readiness discovery, per-device enrollment/supervision/parity validation, a migration status and app-parity report, safe remediation of stuck enrollments, and a migration-ring group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

iPhones and iPads moved from Workspace ONE to Intune — re-assigned in Apple Business Manager, re-enrolled supervised with app and profile parity, and cut over by ring with clear user comms — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WS1IOS-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for a Workspace ONE to Intune iOS/iPadOS migration
    • WS1IOS-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation for stuck iOS/iPadOS migrations (default -WhatIf)
    • WS1IOS-Report.ps1 — fleet migration status and app-parity report for the iOS/iPadOS migration
    • WS1IOS-Set-MigrationRingTargeting.ps1 — create the pilot and broad migration ring groups
    • WS1IOS-Validation.ps1 — per-device check that an iPhone/iPad migrated cleanly to Intune

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
